dataProductsTab.heading: Data Products
dataProductsTab.teamPlaceholder: Role that maintains this product day-to-day
dataProductsTab.purposePlaceholder: What this data product publishes and why
dataProductsTab.usagePlaceholder: How to consume this data product
dataProductsTab.supportPlaceholder: How to get help with this product
dataProductsTab.supportContactHelp: The email address or web page a catalog listing names for support. Some export targets require it.
dataProductsTab.customPropertiesDesc: Arbitrary key-value metadata not covered by the standard fields.
dataProductsTab.resolveTeam: Show who is on the team for data product {{id}}
dataProductsTab.deleteConfirm: Delete data product "{{id}}"? Tables that reference it lose the membership.
dataProductsTab.purposeBody: A data product groups tables published together for consumption, owned by exactly one domain. A table joins a data product only when both share the same domain. Fields follow the ODPS (Open Data Product Standard) vocabulary where Provisa already has the source of truth.
dataProductsTab.title: Data Products
dataProductsTab.tablesDesc: Tables published as this product's output ports. Only tables in the same domain can be selected.
dataProductsTab.commandsDesc: Commands published as part of this data product. Only commands in the same domain can be selected.

detail.dataQualityHint: The product's checks: its expectations on its inputs, its promises on its member tables, and related checks that others (or no one) make on either. Open a check to read its results.
detail.relatedTablesHint: Reachable from this product's tables through an approved relationship, but not (yet) part of it.
detail.relationshipsEmpty: No relationships between this product's tables
detail.lineageHint: Column lineage graph showing this product's tables as the published endpoint, plus every upstream table used to derive them. Informational only — requires the view_governance capability.
detail.outputPortsHint: This product's queryable surface: its member tables and commands. Example queries for each are under Access Patterns.

dataProductsTab.readOnlyHint: You have data_product_read only — an org_admin can grant data_product_rw to edit.
dataProductsTab.retireOnHint: It stays in service until then. Leave it empty for no date.
dataProductsTab.successorHint: Its tables, views and commands move to the successor, a product in the same domain.
dataProductsTab.publishHint: Take this draft live: it is offered to consumers and catalogs.
dataProductsTab.deprecateHint: Mark this live product as on its way out: it stays in service, with a reason and an optional planned retirement.
dataProductsTab.retireHint: Take this product out of service: its tables, views and commands move to a successor in its domain.
dataProductsTab.retireNoMembers: It has no members: a successor is optional.
dataProductsTab.restoreHint: Undo the deprecation (back to live) or the retirement (back to a draft).
